findings.detail: This candidate changes the behavior-pair training stream in addition to appending the proposed stability feature: the file explicitly describes fixing frozen itertools.cycle sampling, and RESAMPLE_PAIRS=True. That is not the frozen baseline quantizer/training setup promised by the specification, so downstream comparisons cannot isolate the stability token.
findings.reproduction: Run the candidate trainer and compare with the stated baseline: this candidate rebuilds/shuffles the pair iterator each epoch (RESAMPLE_PAIRS=True), whereas the documented baseline replays the first cycled pair batches. The behavior loss consequently receives different training pairs even before export.
findings.correction: Use the exact frozen baseline trainer and checkpoint/training budget for this experiment; remove the pair-resampling change from this candidate. Keep the bootstrap perturbation and appended stability-token export as the sole delta.
